lines.text: Dogs everywhere will take one look at the rain and decide they can hold it.
lines.was: Tomorrow, dogs everywhere will take one look at the rain and decide they can hold it.

lines.text: You'll tell people 'it's supposed to rain' like you have sources.
The rain will bring out the snails. Finally, someone you can keep up with.
lines.was: Tomorrow the rain brings out the snails. Finally, someone you can keep up with.

lines.text: Someone from somewhere colder will say 'you call this cold?' while zipping up.
A lot of cold hands will end up on warm necks. Uninvited.
lines.was: Tomorrow, a lot of cold hands will end up on warm necks. Uninvited.

lines.text: You'll rub your hands together like a cartoon villain. It suits you.
lines.was: You'll rub your hands together like a cartoon villain tomorrow. It suits you.

lines.text: Tech billionaires call that a philosophy.
Shame it has to be one of yours.
